steps.comment: capture the full rendered document (doctype + <html>); the bytes stream content-addressed to BYO storage — we keep only the REF, so the result stays a tiny manifest

push.value: { url: pageUrl(), captureRef: resultsDoc.contentId, sha256: resultsDoc.sha256, sizeBytes: resultsDoc.sizeBytes }

push.value: { url: pageUrl(), captureRef: grid.contentId, sha256: grid.sha256, sizeBytes: grid.sizeBytes }
